From 6aaa978c6b6218cfac15fe1dab17c76fe229ce3f Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Jason Gunthorpe <jgg@nvidia.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Apr 2026 13:17:40 -0300
Subject: [PATCH] RDMA/mana: Fix error unwind in mana_ib_create_qp_rss()

Sashiko points out that mana_ib_cfg_vport_steering() is leaked, the normal
destroy path cleans it up.

Cc: stable@vger.kernel.org
Fixes: 0266a177631d ("RDMA/mana_ib: Add a driver for Microsoft Azure Network Adapter")
Link: https://sashiko.dev/#/patchset/0-v1-e911b76a94d1%2B65d95-rdma_udata_rep_jgg%40nvidia.com?part=4
Link: https://patch.msgid.link/r/7-v1-41f3135e5565+9d2-rdma_ai_fixes1_jgg@nvidia.com
Reviewed-by: Long Li <longli@microsoft.com>
Signed-off-by: Jason Gunthorpe <jgg@nvidia.com>

diff --git a/drivers/infiniband/hw/mana/qp.c b/drivers/infiniband/hw/mana/qp.c
index 8e1f052d0ec9..0fbcf449c134 100644
--- a/drivers/infiniband/hw/mana/qp.c
+++ b/drivers/infiniband/hw/mana/qp.c
@@ -217,13 +217,15 @@ static int mana_ib_create_qp_rss(struct ib_qp *ibqp, struct ib_pd *pd,
 		ibdev_dbg(&mdev->ib_dev,
 			  "Failed to copy to udata create rss-qp, %d\n",
 			  ret);
-		goto fail;
+		goto err_disable_vport_rx;
 	}
 
 	kfree(mana_ind_table);
 
 	return 0;
 
+err_disable_vport_rx:
+	mana_disable_vport_rx(mpc);
 fail:
 	while (i-- > 0) {
 		ibwq = ind_tbl->ind_tbl[i];
-- 
2.34.1

## Summary of the Patch

### Modifications in `drivers/infiniband/hw/mana/qp.c`

- **Added a new error-handling label `err_disable_vport_rx`** after the existing `fail` label.
- **Changed the error path** when `ib_copy_to_udata()` fails:
  - Instead of jumping directly to `fail`, the code now jumps to `err_disable_vport_rx`.
  - At `err_disable_vport_rx`, the function `mana_disable_vport_rx(mpc)` is called to release the vport RX resource that was allocated earlier in the function.
  - After that, execution falls through to the existing `fail` label, which continues cleaning up the remaining resources (QPs in the indirection table).

### Relationship Between the Modifications

The change ensures that the call to `mana_ib_cfg_vport_steering()` (indirectly via `mana_disable_vport_rx`) is properly unwound when a late error occurs during `mana_ib_create_qp_rss()`. Previously, only the direct failure path from `mana_ib_cfg_vport_steering()` itself went through `fail`, but errors after that step (e.g., copying to userspace) skipped the vport RX cleanup, causing a resource leak. The new label fills this gap by explicitly calling the cleanup function before falling back to the generic cleanup sequence.
